steps.body: One more means the next number; one less means the number before. After 45 comes 46; before 45 is 44.
steps.narration: One more means the next number; one less means the number before. After forty-five comes forty-six; before forty-five is forty-four.

widget.prompt: Start at 45 and hop one more. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That went one LESS. One more is the next number: 46.
That added a ten. One more is just the next number: 46.

predict.prompt: 45 and one more — which digit will change?
predict.reveal: One more is a single step: the ones digit ticks up to 6 and the tens digit doesn't move at all.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents one more less.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for one more less must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines one more less.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: One less than 60 is 59 — the number just before it.
Count back one from 60 to reach 59.

commonErrors.feedback: That's one MORE. One less means count back: 60 → 59.
That went ten less. One less is just the number before: 59.

steps.body: Sometimes one more rolls a ten. One more than 39 is 40; one less than 40 is 39. The ones roll over.
steps.narration: Sometimes one more rolls a ten. One more than thirty-nine is forty; one less than forty is thirty-nine. The ones roll over.

widget.prompt: Match each number to ONE MORE than it.

pairErrors.feedback: One more than 29 rolls to 30. 51 is one more than 50.
One more than 99 rolls all the way to 100.

widget.missFeedback: One more is the next number: 30, 51, 100.

explanationVariants: One more than 39 is 40 — the ones roll from 9 to 0 and a ten appears.
39, then one more: the 9 rolls to 0 and the tens tick up to 40.

commonErrors.feedback: That wrote 3 and 10 side by side. When 9 rolls over, it becomes 40.
That added a ten. One more than 39 is 40.

widget.fallbackFeedback: One more than 39 is 40 — the ten rolls.

explanationVariants: One less than 70 is 69 — count back one across the ten.
70 back one: the ten breaks and you land on 69.

options.feedback: Yes — count back one from 70 to 69.
71 is one MORE. One less means count back: 69.
That's ten less. One less is just the number before 70: 69.

explanationVariants: One less than 100 is 99 — count back one, breaking the hundred.

commonErrors.feedback: That's one MORE. One less than 100 counts back to 99.
That went ten less. One less than 100 is 99.

steps.teaser: next: ten more and ten less.

concept.body: Slow down. One more than 12 is 13 — the next number. One less than 12 is 11 — the one before.
concept.narration: Slow down. One more than twelve is thirteen — the next number. One less than twelve is eleven — the one before.

explanationVariants: One more than 12 is 13 — the next number.

commonErrors.feedback: That's one LESS. One more is the next number: 13.
That added a ten. One more than 12 is 13.
